title: ul multiversum mod
description: This mod changes the very concept of survival in Minecraft. Death is no longer the final outcome, even in the hardcore world.
body: UL MultiversumUL Multiversum is a mod that fundamentally changes the very concept of survival.⚠️ Work In ProgressPlease note that many features of this mod are currently under development. Everything is subject to change, and mechanics may be reworked as the project evolves.About the ModThis project aims to expand the Minecraft experience by introducing new layers of gameplay, challenging the player's perception of life and death, and adding unique, atmospheric worlds to explore.Key Features:1. The Afterlife DimensionDeath is no longer the end. Instead of a simple respawn, players are transported to the Afterlife dimension.Current State: The way back to the Overworld is relatively simple for now.Future Updates: The process of returning will become increasingly difficult and complex as the mod evolves, turning "coming back" into a true challenge.2. Tatooine DimensionA strange, bleak, and desolate desert world. It's a place characterized by its oppressive emptiness and gloomy atmosphere—somewhere you definitely won't want to stay for long.Developed with a focus on immersive survival mechanics.
